name: Stillmarch
storyline: A thousand years ago the empire of Perpetua measured the continent, raised the Obelisks and then went still. Its cities are ruins now, and its citizens still walk them, unable to finish the sentences they started when everything stopped. Now ships are landing again in the ports the players' ancestors once fled. The newcomers are the Return, coming back to a land nobody remembers. Houses wake the Obelisks, build on Perpetua's foundations, trade and feud. But the brighter and more ordered the world becomes, the easier it is for the Stillness to find it. The Forgotten walk the old roads, and in the forests that swallowed Perpetua's cities the creatures of Slavic and Germanic legend are still waiting.
summary:
Stillmarch is a dark medieval sandbox MMO built around player Houses. Players wake the Obelisks that control each region of a fallen empire and claim the land for their House. A House that holds three regions becomes a Barony, Baronies can crown a King by vote, and the alliances, wars and betrayals between Houses are recorded in the Chronicles. Not every House fights for land: some sell their swords as mercenaries, some run caravans, some found faiths around relics.

Combat is close, over-the-shoulder action with no classes. Each weapon has its own level and skills, and any one-handed weapon can be paired with an off-hand. Players fell trees, mine ore, gather herbs and skin what they hunt, craft their own gear, raise settlements and hire Wayfarers to run their workshops. Rivals can declare war, lay siege to a region and take it. Trade happens face to face, and dying in hostile land costs everything the character carries, armor included. The game has no pay-to-win.
